# stask

Workspace automation for this Rust template is compiled Rust reached through `just`. The root `justfile` is the canonical command surface and command index for developers, AI agents, and local automation; recipes stay thin and dispatch into the composed `cargo stask` runner with `STASK_VIA_JUST=1`.

Keep this crate as the template composition adapter. It owns only explicit bin entrypoints, command-set composition in `lib.rs`, local generated-doc source wiring, startup handling, and local extension registration. Reusable behavior lives in external crates: `strict-stask-core` owns runner, command registration, parser, color, output, context, process, and extension-router primitives; `strict-stask-cargo` owns Rust/Cargo workflow commands, `repo-overview`, reusable agent reports, gate behavior, and command behavior tests; `strict-stask-agents-md` owns generated-doc engine behavior, generated-content provider APIs, changed-path reporting, and fragment migration. Reusable Markdown content lives in `agents-md-rs` under `agents-md/fragments/**`.

Tests follow the same ownership boundary. Keep local tests limited to local composition seams, such as extension-registry assembly. If generated-doc config, provider registration, `repo-overview`, command parsing, runner behavior, or reusable workflow behavior needs coverage, add that coverage in the owning strict repository first, update this template's Git dependency, and verify the consumed behavior here through real `just` commands.

Run `just repo-overview md` or `just repo-overview json` for the live command index, gate policy, workspace members, and generated-doc source facts. Do not duplicate those inventories here.

## Entry Point

`just` lists source-ordered recipes by default. A direct `cargo stask <subcommand>` invocation is rejected by `strict_stask_core::Runner` unless `STASK_VIA_JUST=1` or `CI` is set, so local users and agents share the same command surface while GitHub Actions can still run `cargo stask ci`.

Output color follows `--color <auto|always|never>` / `--no-color` or `STASK_COLOR` / `CARGO_TERM_COLOR`, and the resolved policy is threaded through child tools.

## Generated Markdown

`gen-agent-guidance` regenerates generated Markdown docs from the external template source plus this repository's local overlays:

- `agents-md/fragments/**` is the reusable content package source.
- `docs/fragments/AGENTS.md/*.md` contributes to root `AGENTS.md`.
- `docs/fragments/stask/AGENTS.md/*.md` contributes to `stask/AGENTS.md`.
- `docs/fragments/README.md/*.md` contributes to root `README.md` when present.
- `docs/fragments/stask/README.md/*.md` contributes to `stask/README.md` when present.

Edit fragments, then run `just gen-agent-guidance`. The one-time `just migrate-agent-guidance-fragments` command moves legacy root guidance fragments into target filename directories; normal generation reads the hard-migration `docs/fragments/**` layout.

## Extending Automation

Repository-specific automation belongs behind `just x <name>` through the local extension registry in `stask/src/extensions.rs`. This checkout intentionally starts with `strict_stask_core::empty_extension_command_set(...)`, so `just x` is present and reports the empty-registry diagnostic until a project-specific command is added.

To add a consumer-local extension, replace the empty registry with `strict_stask_core::extension_command_set(...)`, declare the command's arguments in a local module, add a `pub mod` line in `lib.rs`, and dispatch through a local command enum. Do not add local-only behavior to shared `strict-stask-*` crates.

For reusable template-wide Rust/Cargo workflows, change `strict-stask-cargo-rs` first, update this template's Git dependency, and expose the command here with a one-line `justfile` recipe only after the owning crate provides the behavior. For generated-doc engine behavior, change `strict-stask-agents-md-rs`. For runner or extension-router behavior, change `strict-stask-core-rs`.

## Workspace Setup

When a consumer brings this automation shape into a workspace, it also needs the root policy files, workspace lint blocks, workspace dependency entries for `strict-stask-core`, `strict-stask-cargo`, `strict-stask-agents-md`, `agents-md`, and `strict-test-support`, and a thin `justfile` that dispatches into `cargo stask`.

Run `just init` once to install toolchains, components, targets, cargo tools, and the self-refreshing pre-commit hook.
